{{Article header|deck=A Riker-class prison ship at the centre of a mass breakout, a concluded combat campaign, and an unresolved fugitive hunt in Redonesses.}}

{{Callout|type=info|label=Campaign concluded|1=
'''Defeat Criminal Pilots in Redonesses''' ended on '''8 October 3312''' at '''Tier 2 of 5'''. Inara recorded '''8,849 contributors''' and '''116,350,734,905 credits in Combat Bonds'''. The campaign no longer accepts registration or contributions.<ref name="inara-cg">[https://inara.cz/elite/communitygoals/s/ Defeat Criminal Pilots in Redonesses], Inara. Completed campaign listing accessed 8 October 2026.</ref>

EVE-597 was returned to Independent Detention Foundation control. Most escaped prisoners were recovered, but three maximum-security pirate leaders remained missing as of 13 October 3312.<ref name="frontier-subdued">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/prison-ship-break-subdued-in-redonesses Prison Ship Break Subdued in Redonesses], GalNet, Frontier Developments, 8 October 3312.</ref><ref name="frontier-fugitives">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/three-prisoners-missing-following-recent-breakout Three Prisoners Missing Following Recent Breakout], GalNet, Frontier Developments, 13 October 3312.</ref>
}}

'''EVE-597''' is a Riker-class prison ship operated by the Independent Detention Foundation. It normally follows a repeating route through '''Nones''', '''Gliese 506.2''', '''Evenses''' and '''Chematja'''.<ref name="frontier-missing">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/prison-ship-reported-missing-after-failing-scheduled-transit Prison Ship Reported Missing After Failing Scheduled Transit], GalNet, Frontier Developments, 17 September 3312. Accessed 1 October 2026.</ref><ref name="canonn-riker">[https://canonn.science/codex/riker-class-prison-ship Riker-class Reformatory], Canonn Research Group. Accessed 1 October 2026.</ref>

The vessel failed to arrive at Gliese 506.2 after leaving Nones. Commanders located it in '''Redonesses''' on 18 September 3312, transmitting a distress call and hosting a megaship combat encounter.<ref name="gnd-found">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r3zywyRsQyk “Defend Us” Plea from Prison Ship], GalNet News Digest, 18 September 3312. Accessed 20 September 2026.</ref><ref name="wsn-found">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=opqe5NIs2Rg Missing Megaship Found, Rhino Mining Plugin, New Exploration Event & More], ''Witchspace News'', The Buur Pit, 18 September 2026. Accessed 20 September 2026.</ref> GalNet subsequently confirmed that the ship was damaged, its defence turrets were disabled and debris surrounded the vessel.<ref name="frontier-found">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/missing-prison-ship-discovered-adrift-in-redonesses-system Missing Prison Ship Discovered Adrift in Redonesses System], GalNet, Frontier Developments, 22 September 3312. Accessed 1 October 2026.</ref>

On 1 October 3312, the Independent Detention Foundation admitted that a major breakout had taken place. Prisoners controlling EVE-597 launched escape pods, while the Clan of Redonesses attempted to prevent their recapture. The Foundation then opened a combat campaign calling for independent pilots to suppress those criminal forces.<ref name="frontier-breakout">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/galnet/mass-prison-breakout-reported-at-eve-597-reformatory Mass Prison Breakout Reported at EVE-597 Reformatory], GalNet, Frontier Developments, 1 October 3312. Accessed 1 October 2026.</ref>

== Campaign outcome and aftermath ==

Inara recorded the campaign as finished on 8 October 3312. It reached Tier 2 of 5 with 116,350,734,905 credits in Combat Bonds submitted by 8,849 commanders.<ref name="inara-cg" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Contribution bracket !! Final contribution range !! Credit reward
|-
| Top 10 commanders || 908,423,338–1,482,867,988 || 280,000,000 Cr
|-
| Top 25% || 11,212,136–908,423,337 || 220,000,000 Cr
|-
| Top 50% || 3,441,862–11,212,135 || 170,000,000 Cr
|-
| Top 75% || 1,095,853–3,441,861 || 140,000,000 Cr
|-
| Top 100% || 1–1,095,852 || 70,000,000 Cr
|}

The completed listing also displays Mamba and Vulture Crossfire Blue paint jobs, but does not state which contribution brackets qualify for them.<ref name="inara-cg" />

On 8 October, GalNet reported that EVE-597 was back under Independent Detention Foundation control. All convicts still aboard had been secured, and local security reported that the vast majority of prisoners who escaped in pods had been recovered and returned to custody.<ref name="frontier-subdued" />

The Wallglass Investigations Agency was appointed to establish how the prisoners breached their cells in such numbers. Partial telemetry recovered from the ship's communications array indicated that the breakout had been coordinated with support from inside EVE-597. Investigators had not established whether security data was disclosed to an outside party. The Foundation said the prison ship would resume its normal jump itinerary as soon as possible.<ref name="frontier-subdued" />

On 13 October, the Foundation confirmed that three maximum-security prisoners had evaded recapture: '''Gunther Bernhardt''', '''Yaz Murano''', and '''Trey Coombes'''. All three were identified as high-ranking pirate leaders convicted of repeated large-scale criminal activity. Investigators concluded that the wider uprising had served as cover for their planned extraction, but their whereabouts remained unknown.<ref name="frontier-fugitives" />

== Campaign hub ==

The '''Sword of Iustitia''' served as the campaign registration and Combat Bond hand-in point. EDSM data accessed after the campaign identifies it as a Redonesses Defence Party megaship roughly 206 light-seconds from the arrival star, with refuelling, repair, restock, contacts, shipyard and outfitting services.<ref name="edsm-stations">[https://www.edsm.net/api-system-v1/stations?systemName=Redonesses Redonesses station data], EDSM. Live data accessed 8 October 2026.</ref>

The campaign used the following workflow:<ref name="inara-cg" />

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage !! Action
|-
| Register || Commanders signed up for ''Defeat Criminal Pilots in Redonesses'' at the Sword of Iustitia.
|-
| Fight || Participants entered conflict zones in Redonesses and fought the criminal forces assisting the escaping prisoners.
|-
| Contribute || Registered commanders handed Combat Bonds in at the Sword of Iustitia.
|-
| Qualify || At least one bond qualified a commander for a credit reward; the final Inara listing did not specify cosmetic eligibility.
|}

The Sword of Iustitia briefly lacked a mission board when the campaign opened; The Buur Pit reported that this launch-day issue was quickly resolved.<ref name="buur-cg-participation">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tXJiet0ZGgY&t=199s “Anaconda MK2 Hardpoints Clarified, Megaship War Erupts & Much More | Elite Dangerous NEWS”], ''Witchspace News'', The Buur Pit, 2 October 2026, 3:19–4:11. Accessed 3 October 2026.</ref>

Community reporting from The Buur Pit indicated that Combat Bonds earned in on-foot conflict zones in Redonesses also counted toward the Community Goal when fighting against the Clan of Redonesses. After docking at the Sword of Iustitia, commanders could hand those bonds in through the megaship's Contacts panel from the cockpit; visiting Frontline Solutions on foot was not required.<ref name="buur-cg-participation" />

Combat Bonds from the campaign conflict zones were the required contribution. The earlier megaship distress encounter was part of the incident's history, but its attacker-or-defender choice was not the campaign turn-in mechanism.

== Earlier megaship encounter ==

Before the breakout was officially acknowledged, commanders dropping at EVE-597 encountered a megaship combat scenario. The communications panel offered a choice between supporting the defenders and joining the attackers.<ref name="gnd-found" /><ref name="wsn-found" />

[[File:EVE-597_Factions.png|thumb|right|250px|The earlier megaship encounter allowed commanders to defend or attack EVE-597.]]

{| class="wikitable"
! Side in the encounter !! Faction !! Government
|-
| Defending EVE-597 || Clan of Redonesses || Anarchy
|-
| Attacking EVE-597 || Redonesses Defence Party || Dictatorship
|}

The unusual alignment is consistent with Frontier's account: prisoners had taken control of EVE-597 and the Clan of Redonesses was helping the escapees. EDSM data accessed after the campaign shows the War state recovering for both the Clan of Redonesses and Redonesses Defence Party, with the Defence Party in Infrastructure Failure and Redonesses Gold Comms Services still controlling the system. Faction states, control and influence remain dynamic.<ref name="frontier-breakout" /><ref name="edsm-factions">[https://www.edsm.net/api-system-v1/factions?systemName=Redonesses Redonesses faction data], EDSM. Live data accessed 8 October 2026.</ref>
